normalConditions: Pet active base/previous segment has ordinary meaningful user/assistant messages; auto-extraction enabled.

A user-authorized accepted resume follow-up, with a valid idle native source and no pending decision, is due after at least the configured12h idle gap; no taskId short-circuiting into paused-task resume is needed.
wakeFollowUp runs normally with its generated pet-followup-ID-revision clientMessageId; normal healthy worker run completes.
cause: wakeFollowUp creates type chat and generated ID. Shared chat branch begins topic with thatID even for hostWake; controller opens new segment with boundaryBeforeMessageId=ID and closes previous with nextBoundary=ID.
Same worker run marks user injected:true and persists exactID plus injected into message.data.
Closure transcript reader deliberately skips injected user messages; exact boundary locator cannot find thisID and returns null, close immediately returns null before journal/generate/memory.
Backfill reuses stored segment boundaries and same reader/locator; it supplies no fallback for this missing boundary.
candidates.ordinaryImpact: At least the just-closed topic receives no automatic journal extraction/auto-memory under these conditions; a later closure whose start is this stored synthetic boundary has the same missing-start condition.
counterevidenceAndLimits: The independent Core span/context archival path is distinct; do not infer archive failure, raw message deletion, UI frames, cross-account routing or permission bypass.
Old plan explicitly discusses injected skipping versus span archival; retain it as related design boundary, not an exact already-reported journal/followup cause.
notify-only reminders do not go through resume dispatcher. Paused-task direct-control and unavailable/active/pending sources may return early; they are outside this normal accepted branch.
Manual clear/new user paths are not alleged broken. Without enabled extraction or sufficient content there is no same journal promise to lose.
Only static source reasoning, no runtime reproduction; whole assistant/transcript nonstandard writer branches and all dispatch policy paths not exhaustively verified.

normalTimeline.state: S0 is current active segment, has at least3 ordinary meaningful user/assistant messages, has not closed or produced its own journal yet; lastInteractionAt=T0. Earlier already-recorded segments are unaffected.

An accepted registered resume follow-up generates H. beginTurn closes S0 with endH and opens S1 with startH; normal run persists userH injected:true. Immediately after run settles, closureS0 filters outH, cannot find endH, returnsnull before extraction.
A user turn before another idle gap leaves S1 active; it does not erase or repair H boundary.
A normal userU opens S2 and closes S1(startH,endU); reader lacks startH so S1 also returnsnull. S2 and later segments with real user anchors may work normally.

candidates.shutdownBoundary: Not read or alleged: this package does not claim shutdown actively closes a segment. ManualClear plus next real turn can also close one, but the core normal timeline uses two ordinary idle crossings.
candidates.earlierPendingBoundary: No earlier pending closure runtime result assumed. Existing correctly anchored or already-recorded segments can succeed/remain recorded; that does not make the H-anchored segment locatable.
